• Swatch Group è un'azienda multinazionale attiva nella produzione e vendita di orologi finiti e gioielli, movimenti e componenti orologi.
• Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo

• Swatch Group è quindi un importante player nella produzione e nella vendita di sistemi elettronici utilizzati nell'industria orologiera ma anche in altri settori.

• Assicurare la corretta gestione del negozio (pulizia, stoccaggio e spedizione).

Sales Operations Manager - Swatch Group Sales Operations Manager The company The Sales Operations Manager is a key role within EM Microelectronic, reporting directly to the VP Sales & Marketing. This position acts as a strategic and operational bridge between the worldwide Sales & Marketing team and other core departments including Global Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations. The role supports executive decision-making by ensuring accurate data, streamlined processes, and proactive collaboration across functions. This role does not offer any hybrid/remote work possibility. 
• Job description Key 
• Responsibilities Sales Data Management & Reporting Own and manage core sales data Ensure consistency and quality of sales data across departments Monitor performance, identify trends, and highlight areas for improvement Sales Forecasting & Planning Coordinate the global forecasting process with regional Sales Managers, Business Units, and Supply Chain Use historical and current data to drive accurate short- and long-term sales projections Support the definition of annual budgets and multi-year strategic planning Cross-Functional Collaboration (S&OP) Act as a strategic liaison between Sales, Finance, and Operations Support Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand and supply Streamline cross-departmental communication and reduce duplicated efforts Sales Tools, CRM & ERP Systems Lead the implementation and optimization of ERP/CRM tools supporting sales processes Ensure smooth integration and usability of systems, working closely with IT and external consultants Pricing & Revenue Management Prepare and deploy price list updates across platforms Coordinate pricing consistency across teams and regions Sales Enablement & Team Support Provide operational and analytical support to the global sales team, enabling them to focus on customer engagement Assist with transactional tasks, reporting, and the management of sales documents and contracts Support onboarding and ongoing training initiatives related to tools and processes Communication & Organizational Alignment Facilitate structured communication across the sales team and executive leadership Ensure clarity of goals, updates, and priorities across global stakeholders Manage risk assessments and mitigation follow-ups related to sales execution 
• Profile Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and regions (Asia, Europe, Americas) Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Basic financial literacy, including familiarity with budgeting and margin analysis Professional requirements At least 5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or similar roles within the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large datasets Business acumen: Understanding of sales processes, go-to-market strategy, and financial principles such as margin analysis, budgeting, and forecasting Technical proficiency: Advanced Excel and Power BI skills (e.g., pivot tables, data models, automated dashboards) Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems (SAP, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics preferred) Languages Fluent in English (written and spoken) Any other language (mainly french) would be an asset Job location Rue des Sors 3 2074 Marin (Neuchatel) Switzerland Company address EM Microelectronic-Marin Ltd CH-2074 Marin-Epagnier Apply for this job Share this job offer

Sales Operations Manager - Swatch Group

Gestione delle operazioni di vendita
L'azienda
Il Sales Operations Manager è un ruolo chiave all'interno di EM Microelectronic, riportando direttamente al VP Sales & Marketing. Questa posizione funge da ponte strategico e operativo tra il team di vendita e marketing mondiale e altri dipartimenti di base tra cui Global Supply Chain, Finance e Operations. Il ruolo supporta il processo decisionale esecutivo garantendo dati accurati, processi semplificati e collaborazione proattiva tra funzioni.
Questo ruolo non offre alcuna possibilità di lavoro ibrido/remoto.
Descrizione del lavoro
chiave
• responsabilità
Gestione dei dati di vendita & reporting
Possedere e gestire i dati di vendita core
Assicurare coerenza e qualità dei dati di vendita in tutti i reparti
Monitorare le prestazioni, identificare le tendenze e evidenziare le aree per il miglioramento
Previsioni di vendita e pianificazione
Coordinare il processo di previsione globale con Sales Manager regionali, Business Units e Supply Chain
Utilizzare dati storici e attuali per guidare accurate proiezioni di vendita a breve e a lungo termine
Sostenere la definizione dei bilanci annuali e la pianificazione strategica pluriennale
Collaborazione trasversale (S&OP)
Agire come collegamento strategico tra vendite, finanza e operazioni
Support Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processi per allineare la domanda e l'offerta
Semplificare la comunicazione trasversale e ridurre gli sforzi duplicati
Strumenti di vendita, sistemi CRM e ERP
Condurre l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione degli strumenti ERP/CRM che supportano i processi di vendita
Assicurare un'integrazione fluida e l'usabilità dei sistemi, lavorando a stretto contatto con IT e consulenti esterni
Gestione delle entrate e dei prezzi
Preparare e distribuire gli aggiornamenti del listino dei prezzi su piattaforme
Coordinare la coerenza dei prezzi tra team e regioni
Sales Enables & Team Support
Fornire supporto operativo e analitico al team di vendita globale, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sull'impegno del cliente
Assistere con attività transazionali, reporting e la gestione di documenti di vendita e contratti
Sostegno alle iniziative di formazione continua e onboarding relative agli strumenti e ai processi
Comunicazione e allineamento organizzativo
Facilitate la comunicazione strutturata attraverso il team di vendita e la leadership executive
Assicurare chiarezza di obiettivi, aggiornamenti e priorità tra gli stakeholder globali
Gestione delle valutazioni dei rischi e dei follow-up di mitigazione relativi all'esecuzione delle vendite
Profilo
Corso di laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria, Economia o un campo correlato; un master è un plus
Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di collaborare tra funzioni e regioni (Asia, Europa, America)
Altamente organizzato, orientato ai dettagli, e gestione confortevole più priorità in un ambiente veloce
L'alfabetizzazione finanziaria di base, compresa la familiarità con il bilancio e l'analisi dei margini
Requisiti professionali
Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di vendita, operazioni commerciali o ruoli simili all'interno del settore semiconduttore, dell'elettronica o dell'alta tecnologia.
Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di interpretare grandi set di dati
Business acumen: comprensione dei processi di vendita, strategia di go-to-market e principi finanziari come l'analisi dei margini, il bilancio e la previsione
Competenza tecnica:
Competenze avanzate di Excel e Power BI (ad esempio, tabelle pivot, modelli di dati, dashboard automatizzati)
Esperienza pratica con sistemi ERP e CRM (si preferiva SAP, Salesforce o Microsoft Dynamics)

Sales Operations Manager - Swatch Group

Sales Operations Manager
Das Unternehmen
Der Sales Operations Manager ist eine Schlüsselrolle innerhalb von EM Microelectronic und berichtet direkt an den VP Sales & Marketing. Diese Position fungiert als strategische und operative Brücke zwischen dem weltweiten Sales & Marketing-Team und anderen Kernabteilungen wie Global Supply Chain, Finance und Operations. Die Rolle unterstützt die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften, indem sie genaue Daten, optimierte Prozesse und proaktive Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen hinweg gewährleistet.
Diese Rolle bietet keine hybride / Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeit.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
Sales Data Management & Reporting
Eigene und verwalten Kernverkaufsdaten
Gewährleistung der Konsistenz und Qualität der Verkaufsdaten über Abteilungen hinweg
Überwachung der Leistung, Identifizierung von Trends und Hervorhebung von Verbesserungsbereichen
Sales Forecasting & Planung
Koordinieren Sie den globalen Prognoseprozess mit regionalen Vertriebsleitern, Business Units und Supply Chain
Verwenden Sie historische und aktuelle Daten, um genaue kurz- und langfristige Verkaufsprognosen zu erzielen
Unterstützung der Festlegung von Jahresbudgets und mehrjähriger strategischer Planung
Funktionale Zusammenarbeit (S&OP)
Handeln Sie als strategische Verbindung zwischen Vertrieb, Finanzen und Betrieb
Support Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Prozesse zur Abstimmung von Angebot und Nachfrage
Rationalisierung der abteilungsübergreifenden Kommunikation und Reduzierung von Doppelarbeit
Verkaufstools, CRM & ERP-Systeme
Führen Sie die Implementierung und Optimierung von ERP/CRM-Tools zur Unterstützung von Verkaufsprozessen
Gewährleistung einer reibungslosen Integration und Benutzerfreundlichkeit der Systeme durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit der IT und externen Beratern
Pricing & Revenue Management
Bereiten Sie Preislistenaktualisierungen auf allen Plattformen vor
Koordinieren Sie die Preiskonsistenz zwischen Teams und Regionen
Sales Enablement & Team Support
Bereitstellung von operativer und analytischer Unterstützung für das globale Vertriebsteam, damit es sich auf die Kundenbindung konzentrieren kann
Unterstützung bei Transaktionsaufgaben, Reporting und Verwaltung von Verkaufsdokumenten und Verträgen
Unterstützung von Onboarding- und Weiterbildungsinitiativen im Zusammenhang mit Tools und Prozessen
Kommunikation und organisatorische Ausrichtung
Ermöglichen Sie eine strukturierte Kommunikation über das Verkaufsteam und die Führungskräfte hinweg
Gewährleistung der Klarheit der Ziele, Aktualisierungen und Prioritäten für alle globalen Stakeholder
Management von Risikobewertungen und Minderungs-Follow-ups im Zusammenhang mit der Verkaufsausführung
Profil

Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg (Asien, Europa, Amerika)
Hoch organisierte, detailorientierte und komfortable Verwaltung mehrerer Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung
Grundlegende Finanzkompetenz, einschließlich Vertrautheit mit Budgetierung und Margenanalyse
Berufliche Anforderungen
Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Sales Operations, Business Operations oder ähnlichen Rollen in der Halbleiter-, Elektronik- oder High-Tech-Fertigungsindustrie.
Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, große Datensätze zu interpretieren
Geschäftssinn: Verständnis von Verkaufsprozessen, Go-to-Market-Strategie und finanziellen Prinzipien wie Margin-Analyse, Budgetierung und Prognose
Technische Kenntnisse:
Erweiterte Excel- und Power-BI-Fähigkeiten (z. B. Pivot-Tabellen, Datenmodelle, automatisierte Dashboards)

Directeur des opérations commerciales - Swatch Group

Directeur des opérations commerciales
La société
Le responsable des opérations commerciales est un rôle clé au sein d'EM Microelectronic, relevant directement de la VP Sales & Marketing. Ce poste constitue un pont stratégique et opérationnel entre l'équipe de vente et de marketing du monde entier et d'autres départements clés, dont la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale, les finances et les opérations. Ce rôle appuie la prise de décisions par les cadres en assurant l'exactitude des données, la rationalisation des processus et la collaboration proactive entre les fonctions.
Ce rôle n'offre aucune possibilité de travail hybride/à distance.
Description du poste
Clé
• Responsabilités
Gestion des données des ventes et rapports
Posséder et gérer les données de base sur les ventes
Assurer l'uniformité et la qualité des données sur les ventes entre les ministères
Surveiller les résultats, cerner les tendances et mettre en évidence les domaines à améliorer
Prévisions et planification des ventes
Coordonner le processus de prévision mondiale avec les directeurs régionaux des ventes, les unités opérationnelles et la chaîne d'approvisionnement
Utiliser les données historiques et actuelles pour produire des projections précises des ventes à court et à long terme
Appuyer la définition des budgets annuels et de la planification stratégique pluriannuelle
Collaboration interfonctionnelle
Agir comme liaison stratégique entre les ventes, les finances et les opérations
Appuyer les processus de planification des ventes et des opérations afin d'harmoniser la demande et l'offre
Rationaliser la communication interministérielle et réduire les doubles emplois
Outils de vente, CRM et systèmes ERP
Diriger la mise en œuvre et l'optimisation des outils ERP/CRM à l'appui des processus de vente
Assurer une intégration et une utilisation harmonieuses des systèmes, en étroite collaboration avec les services informatiques et les consultants externes
Gestion des prix et des recettes
Préparer et déployer des mises à jour de la liste des prix sur les plateformes
Coordonner la cohérence des prix entre les équipes et les régions
Activement des ventes et soutien d'équipe
Fournir un appui opérationnel et analytique à l'équipe commerciale mondiale, leur permettant de se concentrer sur l'engagement des clients
Aider aux tâches transactionnelles, aux rapports et à la gestion des documents de vente et des contrats
Appuyer les initiatives de formation continue et d'intégration liées aux outils et aux processus
Communication et alignement organisationnel
Faciliter la communication structurée entre l'équipe commerciale et les dirigeants
Assurer la clarté des objectifs, des mises à jour et des priorités des parties prenantes mondiales
Gérer les évaluations des risques et les suivis d'atténuation liés à l'exécution des ventes
Profil
Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, ingénierie, économie, ou un domaine connexe; un diplôme de maîtrise est un plus
Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité de collaborer entre les fonctions et les régions (Asie, Europe, Amériques)
Très organisé, axé sur les détails et confortable gestion de multiples priorités dans un environnement rapide
Alphabétisation financière de base, notamment connaissance de la budgétisation et de l ' analyse de la marge
Exigences professionnelles
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans les opérations de vente, les opérations commerciales ou des rôles similaires dans l'industrie des semi-conducteurs, de l'électronique ou de la fabrication de haute technologie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chef de Groupe Microtechnique - Swatch Group

Chef de Groupe Microtechnique
The company
Swatch Group est un acteur de premier plan de l’horlogerie mondiale. Ses marques horlogères bien connues couvrent toutes les gammes de prix et sont les ambassadrices des montres Swiss Made sur tous les marchés.
En tant que laboratoire de recherche central du groupe, Swatch Group R&D, division Asulab, a pour mission de développer des produits, sous-systèmes et composants horlogers techniquement novateurs de même que les technologies de fabrication indispensables à leur production. Cet objectif est atteint grâce à des projets internes dans divers domaines techniques et la collaboration active avec des universités et des instituts de recherche externes.
Job description
Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Chef(fe) de Groupe – Microtechnique qui rejoindra une entreprise R&D multidisciplinaire afin de développer des composants, systèmes et
produits novateurs pour les entreprises du Swatch Group.
Tâches principales :
Responsabilité et gestion d’une petite équipe d’ingénieurs multidisciplinaires et d’horlogers
Supervision et promotion de projets innovants dans le domaine des montres et mouvements horlogers, mécaniques comme électroniques
Développement de concepts et technologies originaux permettant d’améliorer la précision et / ou l’autonomie des mouvements horlogers
Développement de systèmes de caractérisation et mesure
Planification et suivi de plusieurs projets, établissement de budgets annuels
Elaboration et suivi de projets en partenariat académique et industriel
Application de méthodes liées aux standards de qualité
Rédaction de rapports techniques et administratifs
Référence technique dans le domaine de l’horlogerie pour la Direction
Développement intellectuel, créativité et esprit d’innovation
Profile
Ingénieur EPF (ou équivalent) en microtechnique ou en physique, un doctorat est un plus
Esprit créatif, visionnaire et qui ne craint pas de se lancer dans l’inconnu
Intérêt marqué pour l’innovation et les technologies avancées
Expérience dans le domaine de la conception et la fabrication des montres électroniques et mécaniques
Expérience dans des projets académiques ou industriels multidisciplinaires
Curiosité technique et dévouement
Professional requirements
Compétences:
Excellentes connaissances dans la construction, la fabrication et le montage des mouvements horlogers électroniques et mécaniques
Bonnes connaissances en transducteurs et capteurs utilisant des couplages électromagnétiques, piézoélectriques, ou électrostatiques
Connaissances de base en électronique
Aisance dans l’interaction avec des scientifiques et technologues aux compétences diverses
Capacité à anticiper les besoins d’une équipe d’ingénieurs très qualifiés
Capacité à fédérer une équipe d’ingénieurs autour de projets techniques exigeants
Capacité à écouter, communiquer, collaborer et s’intégrer au sein d’une entreprise multidisciplinaire
Capacité à développer une vision globale dans le cadre de plusieurs projets
Capacité à communiquer vers l’extérieur (sociétés du Groupe Swatch ou externes)
Languages
Langues:
- Français : courant
- Anglais : courant
- Allemand : une bonne compréhension est un plus

2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
Suisse

ICT Security Engineer Content Delivery and Edge Services - Swatch Group ICT Security Engineer Content Delivery and Edge Services Introduction de la société We don't exclusively manufacture legendary watches; we keep in time with technology! The Swatch Group Services' IT division plays a key role in the digital transformation of a global leader in watchmaking. At the heart of innovation, you will help design high-performing technological solutions serving iconic brands. For our growing team into the Systems & Infrastructure team, we are looking for a motivated: ICT Security Engineer (Content Delivery & Edge Services) Description du poste You will design, implement, and maintain Akamai security and performance solutions to ensure the optimal security and availability of Swatch Group’s digital platforms. You will collaborate with internal teams and external providers to integrate CDN services into our infrastructure, automate workflows, and enhance global content distribution for Swatch Group brands. In this role, you will be responsible to: Design, deploy, and optimize Akamai CDN solutions (Ion, Image Manager, Kona Site Defender, EdgeWorkers) for high availability and low latency; Implement edge caching strategies, traffic offload, and acceleration techniques to improve web performance; Implement and maintain security and bot management rules; Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for CDN configuration and automation; Collaborate with application teams to ensure seamless integration of CDN services with enterprise platforms; Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) for CDN and cloud environments using tools like Terraform or Ansible; Monitor and analyze CDN performance metrics, availability, and security posture using Akamai Control Center and analytics tools; Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to CDN security; Ensure compliance with security best practices for CDN and edge deployments Profil Bachelor degree or equivalent in Computer Science; Certifications such as GIAC GWAS, Azure Security Engineer, Palo Alto PCNSE and Akamai Certified Professional are a plus; Good knowledge of enterprise security technologies: firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPN, endpoint protection, WAF; Good knowledge of web application security and CDN integration across digital platforms; Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, CircleCI); Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting languages (Python, Bash); Knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP); Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic stack); 
• Compétences requises Professional experience of minimum 5 years in an equivalent role Effective communication across technical and non-technical teams; Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset; Detail-oriented and precise in execution; Service-oriented with a strong customer focus. descriptionByLocale.it:
Spécialiste systèmes industriels (H/F) - Swatch Group

Spécialiste systèmes industriels (H/F)
Introduction de la société
OMEGA est une prestigieuse marque horlogère mondialement connue pour ses exigences de qualité, précision et innovation depuis plus de 170 ans. Nos montres comptent parmi les plus belles au monde et se caractérisent par leur technologie de pointe et leur style intemporel.
Au cours de notre longue histoire, nous avons battu des records de précision, redéfini le chronométrage sportif et maintenu notre position à la pointe de la Haute Horlogerie.
En tant que marque internationale, nous sommes toujours intéressés à rencontrer de futurs collègues souhaitant contribuer au travail de nos équipes sur presque chaque continent à l'aide de leurs talents, ambitions et inspirations.
Description du poste
• Assurer le support technique et opérationnel des systèmes de mesure intégrant des technologies embarquées, en garantissant leur performance, leur fiabilité et leur évolutivité.
• Contribuer activement au développement, à l’optimisation des méthodes, à l’analyse des données de mesure et aux projets d’amélioration continue, dans un environnement orienté industrie 4.0.
• Systèmes industriels & embarqués
• Assurer le suivi et l’intégrité des données issues des équipements
• Participer à l’intégration et à l’évolution des systèmes embarqués
• Contribuer aux projets liés à l’IoT, connectivité et industrie 4.0
• Développer ou améliorer des solutions de visualisation et d’analyse (ex : Power BI)
• Analyse & Support technique
• Assurer le support technique de niveau avancé sur les équipements de mesure et systèmes embarqués
• Diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements et piloter leur résolution avec les équipes internes et fournisseurs
• Mener et suivre les études de validation
• Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la résolution des problématiques techniques
• Garantir la disponibilité et la performance des systèmes
• Développement & Qualification
• Générer, adapter et implémenter les méthodes nécessaires à la qualification de nouveaux produits sur les équipements de mesure
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus et méthodes de qualification
• Assurer le support technique aux utilisateurs en horaire atypique
• Projet & Coordination
• Participer ou piloter des projets techniques transverses
• Collaborer avec les départements (qualité, industrialisation, IT, production, méthodes)
• Contribuer à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs
• Profil
• Diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent en : Systèmes embarqués, Systèmes industriels, Électronique / automatique / microtechnique
• Technicien confirmé avec forte orientation systèmes embarqués (atout)
• Profil ingénieur ou équivalent orienté terrain
• Forte curiosité pour les technologies
• Capacité à structurer, analyser et proposer des solutions
• Capacité à vulgariser et à accompagner les équipes opérationnelles
• Esprit analytique
• Goût pour les environnements pluridisciplinaires
• Proactivité, autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Compétences requises
• Connaissances en systèmes embarqués, capteurs, acquisition de données
• Intérêt ou expérience en IoT / industrie 4.0
• Bonne compréhension des systèmes de mesure et environnements industriels
• Compétences en analyse de données (Power BI, Excel avancé)
• Connaissances en programmation (atout)
• Expérience en méthodes industrielles / industrialisation
• Capacité à comprendre les interfaces IT / équipements
• Aisance dans la rédaction de documentation technique
• Langues
• Français : courant (oral & écrit)
• Anglais : bon niveau (oral & écrit)
• Lieu de travail
• Rue Jakob-Stämpfli - Jakob-Stämpfli-Strasse 96
• 2502 Biel/Bienne (Bern)
• Suisse
• Adresse de l'entreprise
• Omega SA
• Rue Jakob Stämpfli 96
• CH-2502 Bienne

descriptionByLocale.fr: Solution Architect ANAPLAN / Model Builder ANAPLAN - Swatch Group Solution Architect ANAPLAN / Model Builder ANAPLAN Introduction de la société OMEGA est une prestigieuse marque horlogère mondialement connue pour ses exigences de qualité, précision et innovation depuis plus de 170 ans. Nos montres comptent parmi les plus belles au monde et se caractérisent par leur technologie de pointe et leur style intemporel. Au cours de notre longue histoire, nous avons battu des records de précision, redéfini le chronométrage sportif et maintenu notre position à la pointe de la Haute Horlogerie. En tant que marque internationale, nous sommes toujours intéressés à rencontrer de futurs collègues souhaitant contribuer au travail de nos équipes sur presque chaque continent à l'aide de leurs talents, ambitions et inspirations. Description du poste Assurer la conception, le développement, la maintenance et l’évolution des modèles Anaplan supportant les processus de planification Supply Chain. Vous garantirez et participerez activement à la définition, conception, au développement, test et déploiement des modèles d’application Anaplan pour soutenir les processus d’entreprise et les besoins métiers. Tout en garantissant aux utilisateurs un accès (gestion des autorisations & rôles), un support (formation & documentation) et un fonctionnement optimal de l’application (maintenance & support des fonctionnalités et data), vous serez moteur pour proposer des recommandations et évolutions de la solution et garant de leur mise en œuvre dans le respect de la Roadmap de l’application définie. En tant qu’acteur central, vous veillez à la cohérence et à la performance des solutions. Vous contribuez également à l’amélioration continue des modèles Anaplan, en intégrant les meilleures pratiques et en optimisant durablement leurs performances au service des besoins métiers. Profil Niveau supérieur, ingénieur ou jugé équivalent (3 ans d’expérience). Vous disposez d’une certification Solution Architect Anaplan ou Model Builder niveau 3 minimum, complétée par une expérience significative en conception et architecture de modèles. Vous bénéficiez de très bonnes expériences dans les processus de planification de la Supply Chain. Une évolution vers l’accompagnement de projets d’amélioration de nos processus d’exécution Supply est possible. Très orienté sur la collaboration, agile, structuré, vous êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire et exigeant un fort engagement sur le long terme. Vous êtes également doté d’une forte aptitude à la réflexion critique, à la résolution de problème, et vous vous distinguez par vos aptitudes analytiques et conceptuelles. ## Sales & Marketing Manager Swiss Market - Swatch Group

## La société
Fondée en 1918, MIDO allie haute précision, tradition, excellence technique et design intemporel pour créer des garde-temps destinés à accompagner les moments importants de la vie. MIDO est présente dans 70 pays à travers un réseau de 2 300 points de vente officiels. Basée au Locle, la marque fait partie du Swatch Group, leader mondial de l’industrie horlogère.

## Description
Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un·e Sales & Marketing Manager Marché Suisse, basé·e au Locle.

## Mansioni
- Responsabilité globale du chiffre d’affaires, des volumes de vente et de la rentabilité sur le marché suisse
- Gestion et développement d’environ 70 concessionnaires et comptes clés
- Acquisition de nouveaux partenaires commerciaux et optimisation du réseau de distribution existant
- Garantie des niveaux de stock optimaux et d’un merchandising de qualité sur les points de vente
- Planification et organisation de formations pour le personnel de vente
- Développement et mise en œuvre de plans marketing et commerciaux pour le marché suisse
- Préparation et déploiement des actions de lancement de nouveaux produits
- Élaboration et suivi du budget annuel
- Management d’une collaboratrice en administration/vente ainsi que d’une décoratrice

## Profil
- Personnalité persuasive et dotée d’excellentes compétences en communication
- Grande autonomie et capacité à définir clairement les priorités
- Fort sens du service et excellentes aptitudes en négociation
- Orientation résultats et excellentes capacités analytiques (compréhension des chiffres, KPIs, prévisions)
- Aptitude à développer des partenariats à long terme et à raisonner de manière stratégique
- Disponibilité à voyager environ 80 % en Suisse et 20 % de présence au siège au Locle

## Requisiti professionali
- Minimum 5 ans d’expérience réussie dans la vente dans les secteurs de la mode, du luxe, des accessoires, de la cosmétique ou de l’horlogerie, avec une solide expérience en marketing
- Formation dans les domaines de la vente, du marketing, de la gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe

## Lingue
- Langue maternelle française ou allemande, avec d’excellentes connaissances de l’autre langue (oral et écrit)
- Bonnes connaissances de l’anglais

- Suisse

Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more. Main Function To provide exceptional levels of customer service to all clients. Merchandise, promote and sale of all OMEGA products. Meeting all sales targets and Boutique objectives. Key Responsibilities Sales
• Greet and serve all clients providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that clients can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other OMEGA products.
• Provide reliable information to clients in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every client, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique. Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries. Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credit cards. Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards. Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present and conduct themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international clients and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues. Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and proactive, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers. Other
• To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager. Professional requirements
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Previous experience from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail back ground.

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville - Swatch Group OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville The company OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
• Job description We are seeking an experienced, luxury retail Boutique Manager to provide leadership in our prestigious boutique. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Luxury Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and exceeding goals, whist delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills.

Ausbildung zum Elektroniker für Geräte und Systeme (all genders) ab August 2026
The company
Hinter jeder sportlichen Leistung stehen Jahre des Trainings und der Selbstüberwindung. Hinter jedem Ergebnis steht Wissen, Erfahrung, Hochtechnologie und die Präzision von Swiss Timing. Als Tochterunternehmen von Swiss Timing realisiert die ST Sportservice GmbH seit mehr als 25 Jahren den Service bei internationalen Sportgroßveranstaltungen. Wir agieren auf höchstem Niveau in einem einzigartigen Umfeld.
Um unsere Lösungen weiter zu entwickeln, suchen wir ständig leistungsbereite, motivierte, innovative Mitarbeiter. Als Partner des Internationalen Olympischen Komitees werden wir den Zeitnahme-, TV-Grafik- und Datenservice bei den Olympischen Sommer- und Winterspielen bis ins Jahr 2032 und darüber hinaus realisieren. Dazu brauchen wir Dich!
Job description
Als Elektroniker der Fachrichtung Geräte und Systeme bei ST SPORTSERVICE fertigst, montierst, prüfst, testest und reparierst Du Komponenten und elektronische Sportmessgeräte die bei internationalen Sportevents eingesetzt werden. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichsten Werkzeugen, kleinen Bauteilen und Schaltplänen oder nutzt Mess- und Prüfgeräte um zu erkennen, ob die von Dir gefertigten Komponenten und Geräte fehlerfrei funktionieren. Ein besonderes Highlight Deiner Ausbildung sind Deine Einsätze als Techniker bei internationalen Sportevents, wie z.B. Weltcups, Weltmeisterschaften oder Olympische Spiele, in den großen Stadien und Arenen der Welt.
Deine 
• Aufgaben:
Bereitstellung von Geräten und technischen Komponenten
Pflege, Wartung und Reparatur des Equipments
Vorbereitung des Equipments incl. Fertigung, Installation, Konfiguration und Systemtest
Auf-und Abbau, Bedienung und technischer Support bei internationalen Sportevents vor Ort
Nutzerunterstützung und Einweisungen
Profile
Du bist sind ein Teamplayer und verfügst über eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit? Du arbeitest gern an verantwortungsvollen 
• Aufgaben und eignest Dir selbständig neues Wissen an? Du begeisterst Dich für Sport und wünschst Dir außerdem eine langfristige Perspektive?
Freue Dich auf:
selbständiges Arbeiten in einem tollen Team
eine praxisnahe und abwechslungsreiche Ausbildung mit Reisen zu internationalen Sportveranstaltungen
attraktive Sozialleistungen und faire Ausbildungsvergütung
berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem sehr dynamischen und internationalen Arbeitsumfeld
Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagefähige Bewerbung mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Foto, letztem Zeugnis und Bescheinigungen über Praktika.
Professional requirements
Angestrebte oder abgeschlossene Fachhochschulreife Technik oder Hochschulreife
Führerschein Klasse B
Ausgeprägtes Interesse für Sport und Technik
Gute Vorkenntnisse im Bereich Elektronik oder Hardware
Sicherer Umgang mit IT-Technologie, MS Windows und MS Office
Gutes Qualitätsbewusstsein mit einem ausgeprägten Anspruch an die eigene Arbeit
Gerne unterwegs, auch am Wochenende
Languages
Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique. Retail Sales Advisor Tissot - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor Tissot
The company
Tissot, watchmakers blending tradition and pioneering spirit since 1853, nestled in the Swiss mountains of Le Locle. Tissot crafts watches that become the storytellers of life's voyage: it's not just the destination that matters, but the importance of the path filled with significant milestones and unforgettable memories. The brand’s ambassadors, including American basketball star Damian Lillard, Italian motorcycling sensation Enea Bastianini, Slovenian cyclist Primož Roglič, and Chinese Actors Liu Yifei and Simon Gong exemplify the hours of dedication preceding one’s excellence. On a broader stage, Tissot also partners with the NBA, MotoGPTM, and the Tour de France as their Official Timekeeper.
Discover Tissot’s collections: T-Touch, PRX, Chemin des Tourelles. Every Swiss timepiece crafted embodies a fusion of heritage and innovation, and while priced accessibly, stands as an enduring legacy defying the constraints of time. Going beyond watchmaking and timekeeping, Tissot accompanies individuals in every moment, celebrating not only the achievements, but the journey itself.
Job description
• Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Tissot products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
• Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
• Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency.
• Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
• Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present, and conduct, themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international customers and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly to consumers and colleagues.
• Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
• Profile
• Essential
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Preferably from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail background.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for Tissot, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Preferred
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
• Ability to communicate in other languages for example, Mandarin or Arabic.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain - Swatch Group Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain The company Blancpain, founded in 1735 by Jehan-Jacques Blancpain in the Swiss Jura, Blancpain is known as the world’s oldest watch brand. Over the centuries since its foundation, the Maison has maintained its commitment to innovate and has constantly pushed the limits of watchmaking. At Blancpain, the expression "Innovation is our tradition" is a fundamental guiding principle. The Fifty Fathoms collection embodies Blancpain's passion for the underwater world that was originally expressed in 1953 with the presentation of the first modern diver’s watch Fifty Fathoms. With the creation of the Blancpain Ocean Commitment, the brand pays homage to its Brand’s significant historical links with the ocean, through the support for ocean exploration and numerous collaborative initiatives for biodiversity preservation with local communities, which has been lasting for the past seven decades. As part of the Art of Living platform, Blancpain also cultivates special ties with the greatest award-winning chefs, the Michelin Guide, Relais & Chateaux and Bocuse d’Or. 
• Job description Key 
• Responsibilities Sales and Business Development Provide excellent client experience and timely, pertinent follow-up for both prospective clients and owners (Customer service) Propose clients for, and participate in, local activation events in line with the Brand Universe Support colleagues in their sales by helping to prepare invoices, gifts, packaging Ensure requests and enquiries (online, email, phone) are followed up in a timely manner Develop and maintain a high level of sales technique and watchmaking savoir-faire knowledge Follow-up with customer repairs liaising with customer care in Southampton and Swiss headquarters. Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service. Placing orders for Blancpain accessories, ensuring stock is upto date and available Boutique Operations Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc. Understand and respect all operating and security guidelines Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces 
• Profile Preferred 
• Profile Previous sales experience in a luxury Retail boutique or Hospitality industry Excellent client service and attention to details Entrepreneurial spirit to develop your own business and build long-lasting client relationships Team player with good interpersonal skills and a "can do" attitude Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning Strong interest in the universes of Fine Watchmaking and Arts de Vivre Job location 11 New Bond Street W1S 3SR W1S 3SR London (London) United Kingdom Company address The Swatch Group (UK) Limited 77 Marsh Wall 12th Floor London E14 9SH Apply for this job Share this job offer
descriptionByLocale.it:
Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain
The company
Blancpain, founded in 1735 by Jehan-Jacques Blancpain in the Swiss Jura, Blancpain is known as the world’s oldest watch brand.
Over the centuries since its foundation, the Maison has maintained its commitment to innovate and has constantly pushed the limits of watchmaking. At Blancpain, the expression "Innovation is our tradition" is a fundamental guiding principle.
The Fifty Fathoms collection embodies Blancpain's passion for the underwater world that was originally expressed in 1953 with the presentation of the first modern diver’s watch Fifty Fathoms.
With the creation of the Blancpain Ocean Commitment, the brand pays homage to its Brand’s significant historical links with the ocean, through the support for ocean exploration and numerous collaborative initiatives for biodiversity preservation with local communities, which has been lasting for the past seven decades.
As part of the Art of Living platform, Blancpain also cultivates special ties with the greatest award-winning chefs, the Michelin Guide, Relais & Chateaux and Bocuse d’Or.
Job description
Key 
• Responsibilities
Sales and Business Development
Provide excellent client experience and timely, pertinent follow-up for both prospective clients and owners (Customer service)
Propose clients for, and participate in, local activation events in line with the Brand Universe
Support colleagues in their sales by helping to prepare invoices, gifts, packaging
Ensure requests and enquiries (online, email, phone) are followed up in a timely manner
Develop and maintain a high level of sales technique and watchmaking savoir-faire knowledge
Follow-up with customer repairs liaising with customer care in Southampton and Swiss headquarters.
Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
Placing orders for Blancpain accessories, ensuring stock is upto date and available
Boutique Operations
Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
Understand and respect all operating and security guidelines
Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces
Profile
Preferred 
• Profile
Previous sales experience in a luxury Retail boutique or Hospitality industry
Excellent client service and attention to details
Entrepreneurial spirit to develop your own business and build long-lasting client relationships
Team player with good interpersonal skills and a "can do" attitude
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning
Strong interest in the universes of Fine Watchmaking and Arts de Vivre
Job location

W1S 3SR London (London)
United Kingdom

descriptionByLocale.it: Sales Assistant part time - Milano - contratto temporaneo - Swatch Group Sales Assistant part time - Milano - contratto temporaneo Azienda Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo stesso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti. Descrizione del posto DINAMICITA’, SFIDA, INNOVAZIONE, PASSIONE, sono parole nelle quali ti riconosci? Allora siamo noi il tuo futuro lavorativo! The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. ricerca nuovi talenti da inserire nei nostri negozi Corporate a marchio SWATCH di Milano come venditori part time, con contratto temporaneo. In qualità di sales assistant garantirai un’esperienza di vendita eccellente ai nostri clienti, dal punto di vista della cura e realizzazione dei desideri. Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. Parteciperai all’organizzazione del negozio assicurandoti che il punto vendita, il back office e lo stock siano sempre in ordine. Inoltre garantirai la corretta presentazione dell'immagine dei brand SWATCH e FLIK FLAK. Il vostro profilo - Hai esperienza nel Retail (vendita/gestione resi/ordini etc..) - Hai orientamento commerciale - Sei dinamico e flessibile - Sei disponibile a lavorare su turni avvicendati - Hai buone doti relazionali e buone capacità comunicative - Hai una buona capacità di identificare gli interlocutori ed adattare la comunicazione e l’interazione con essi a seconda delle situazioni (ad es. gestione obiezioni e conflitti) - Sei un problem solver di natura Condizioni professionali Hai dimestichezza con il PC ed il pacchettoOffice e gli applicativi di comunicazione. Conosci i principali strumenti informatici ed hai un’elevata predisposizione all’uso della tecnologia. Per qualcuno l’orologio misura “solo” il tempo, per noi scandisce in ogni minuto la nostra vera passione! Unisciti a NOI! Vieni a far parte del nostro Team! Conoscenze delle lingue Hai un’ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, la conoscenza di altre lingue sarà considerata un plus. Persona di contatto Marica Losciuto Luogo di lavoro 20121 Milano (Lombardia) Italia Company address The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. Nous n'avons de cesse de proposer des garde-temps toujours plus fascinants, alliant complications techniques et esthétique épurée. Description du poste Au sein de l’équipe Coordination Développement Produits (CODE), vous prendrez en charge la gestion complète des projets, en assurant la coordination entre les différentes équipes et en veillant au respect des délais ainsi qu’au maintien de standards de qualité exigeants.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chef de projet Coordination Développement Produits - Swatch Group

• Chef de projet Coordination Développement Produits
• Introduction de la société
• Symbole de patrimoine historique et culturel ainsi que d'avant-garde technologique, Breguet s'inscrit en tant que référence absolue en matière de haute horlogerie.
• Nous n'avons de cesse de proposer des garde-temps toujours plus fascinants, alliant complications techniques et esthétique épurée.
• Description du poste
Au sein de l’équipe Coordination Développement Produits (CODE), vous prendrez en charge la gestion complète des projets, en assurant la coordination entre les différentes équipes et en veillant au respect des délais ainsi qu’au maintien de standards de qualité exigeants.
Vos responsabilités
• Organiser les projets (Structure/ Ressources Humaines et moyens/ Planification / Budget, etc.)
• Coordonner les équipes Projet
• Contribuer activement à la définition du cahier des charges Produit
• Assurer le maintien des objectifs définis dans le cahier des charges
• Animer les séances de projets et en rédiger les procès verbaux
• S’assurer que les décisions à prendre soient cohérentes avec les objectifs du projet
• Être garant du bon fonctionnement du projet selon les valeurs de l’entreprise
• Assurer la bonne communication (actions et décisions) dans l’équipe de projet avec les différents départements et la gouvernance
• Établir les reportings et la documentation globale des projets
• Effectuer les débriefings et déterminer les plans d’actions liés à l’amélioration continue
• Présenter les nouveaux produits lors de divers évènements
• Profil
• Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de constructeur en microtechnique ou horloger
• Vous disposez d’une formation en gestion de projet / certification CAPM, PMP ou équivalent
• Vous avez une expérience significative dans le développement de produits, idéalement dans le secteur de la haute horlogerie
• Compétences requises
• Vous appréciez l'autonomie dans la réalisation de vos fonctions et faites preuve de rigueur tout en étant flexible et polyvalent
• Intègre et de confiance, vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication
• Langues
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral
• Personne de contact
• Elsa GIVERNAUD
• HRBP
• Lieu de travail
• Rue Alfred Lugrin, 2

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Swatch Full Time Keyholder - NY NY Hotel (Las Vegas)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.

## Job Description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
As we prepare for the store reopening, we are expanding the team with additional positions.

## Ideal Candidate
- Retail sales experience
- Keyholder background
- Exceptional customer service skills
- Approachable demeanor
- Ability to meet or exceed sales objectives
- Strong desire to learn about our timepieces

## Hourly Rate
- $17.50 - $19.50/Hrly. (Plus Commission)

## Profile
- Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Reach & exceed your sales goals
- Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
- Handle multi-tasking with ease
- Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment

## Professional Requirements
- 2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
- Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
- Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
- Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
- Able to plan, set and achieve goals
- Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills

## Benefits Program
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
- Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
- 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
- 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
- Holiday pay
- Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
- Employee product discount
- Internal transfer and growth potential
- $500 Employee Referral Bonuses

## Compensation
- Base Pay plus Commission

## Job Location
- South Las Vegas Boulevard 3790
- 89109 Las Vegas NV (Nevada)
- United States

## Company Address
- The Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc.
- 800 Waterford Way
- Suite 1000
- Miami, FL 33126

Store Manager Bilbao - Swatch Group

Store Manager Bilbao
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
SWATCH has an exciting opportunity for a Store Manager to join one of our stores in Bilbao.
As a Store Manager your main tasks will be:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Profile
The ideal candidate should be an experienced retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills.
Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to Retail.
The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus.
Professional requirements
Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Store needs.
Availability for shift work.
Intermediate level of informatics (Office).
Languages
Conversation level of English.
Knowledge in other language would be a plus.

# Full-Time Sales Lead (West Edmonton Mall) - Swatch Group

## La società
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e vi aggiunge la propria scintilla di creatività. Pertanto, Swatch viene considerato una tela sulla quale sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile all'avanguardia, look di tendenza e accenti friendly con la tecnologia hanno tutti contribuito all'ammirazione di possedere uno Swatch.

## Mansioni
Come Swatch Sales Lead, riferirai al Responsabile del Negozio e aiuterai in tutte le operazioni quotidiane. Anche se la tua attenzione sarà sulle iniziative di vendita, dovrai anche coach i venditori per raggiungere i loro obiettivi di prestazione mentre incarnano le competenze fondamentali di Swatch: Focus sul cliente, Ambizione per i risultati, Costruzione di squadre e relazioni efficaci, Creatività e Risoluzione dei problemi e Umiltà e Integrità.

### Responsabilità
- Servizio clienti e generazione delle vendite: Fai da esempio nel fornire un eccellente servizio clienti, imposta gli obiettivi di vendita, coach la squadra per raggiungerli e assicurati che le conoscenze del prodotto siano adeguate.
- Operazioni: Gestisci le operazioni quotidiane, pianifica il personale in modo efficiente, controlla la retribuzione, adatti i processi di controllo dell'inventario e assicurati che tutti i resoconti siano accurati e tempestivi.
- Gestione del personale: Sorveglia i processi di reclutamento, formazione e disciplinare per garantire una squadra ad alte prestazioni, promuovi un ambiente di lavoro positivo e gestisci le valutazioni delle prestazioni e i piani di sviluppo.
- Merchandising visivo: Esegui i lanci del prodotto in linea con gli standard dell'azienda e mantieni la presentazione del negozio.
- Conformità: Mantieni gli standard di sicurezza, fai da modello di politica e procedura.

### Condizioni di lavoro
Il lavoro richiede uno sforzo fisico moderato e una significativa camminata e permanenza in piedi per la maggior parte di ogni turno. Anche se questa posizione ha un basso rischio di infortunio, la posizione richiede il sollevamento, la spinta, la trazione e il mantenimento (fino a 35 libbre e oltre con appoggio appropriato) di scatole e elementi del negozio, nonché una significativa attenzione quando si completa la documentazione, la gestione del denaro o l'uso del POS.

## Profilo
- Disponibilità a lavorare i turni di apertura e chiusura; orari flessibili, compresi i fine settimana e i giorni festivi.
- Forte capacità comunicativa (verbale e scritta), comprese le capacità di costruzione delle relazioni.
- Deve essere unself-starter che lavora bene sia in modo indipendente che in ambienti di squadra.
- Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro, conciso e comprensibile.
- Capacità di leadership efficaci per mentor e motivare la squadra di vendita al dettaglio.
- Orientamento ai risultati con un alto livello di energia e entusiasmo.
- Requisiti professionali
- Almeno 2 anni di esperienza di leadership nel settore della moda e/o degli accessori.
- Capacità informatiche intermedie con conoscenze di lavoro di MS Office.
- Almeno 4 anni di esperienza nel servizio clienti.
- Esperienza nel lavoro con i sistemi POS.

## Cosa offriamo
- Stipendio orario di partenza di $18,90 più bonus mensili di prestazione.
- Benefit:
  - Copertura sanitaria, compresa la copertura dentale e della vista
  - Contribuzioni al piano pensionistico con corrispondenza dell'azienda
  - Sconto aziendale
  - Assicurazione sulla vita

## Contatto
- Indirizzo del lavoro: 170 Street NW, T5T 4J2 Edmonton AB T5T 4J2, Alberta, Canada
- Indirizzo della società: The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd., 555, Richmond Street West, Suite 1105, CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Swatch Part Time Keyholder - NY NY Hotel (Las Vegas)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.

## Job Description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
As we prepare for the store reopening, we are expanding the team with additional positions.

## Job Description:
At Swatch we provide our Retail Key holders with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.
Hourly Rate: $17.50 Hrly. (Plus Commission)

## Profile
- Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Reach & exceed your sales goals
- Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
- Handle multi-tasking with ease
- Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment

## Requirements
- 2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
- Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
- Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
- Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
- Able to plan, set and achieve goals
- Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills

## Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer the following benefits to our part-time positions:
- Excellent health insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Employee product discount
- TransitChek Program - Save money on commuting to work and/or parking with pre-tax dollars
- Internal transfer and growth potential
- Compensation: Base Pay plus Commission
For more information please see [https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/](https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/)

So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. ## Descrizione del Lavoro
Come Sales Associate con Tissot U.S., il ruolo sarà responsabile per dimostrare un servizio clienti eccezionale secondo gli standard della marca, generare vendite, merceologizzare e garantire gli asset aziendali. Sarà previsto aiutare le iniziative di outreach clienti, costruire la consapevolezza della marca, assistere alle operazioni quotidiane della sede. Tutti i ruoli supportano e assistono la squadra di management nel raggiungimento di tutti i obiettivi di servizio clienti e vendite.

## Profilo
### Principali Compiti e Responsabilità
- Fornire un'esperienza unica e speciale a tutti i clienti
- Raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di vendita
- Mantenere e crescere i clienti esistenti; tenere registri dei milestone e dei gusti e obiettivi dei clienti per future acquisizioni
- Assistere al processo di vendita secondo i protocolli stabiliti dalla sede
- Comunicare le richieste dei clienti alla gestione
- Assistere alla presentazione dei rapporti quotidiani e delle riconciliazioni delle vendite
- Assistere al processo di gestione e rifornimento del merceologico e monitorare il conto del banco
- Sviluppare la base di clienti esistenti e raggiungere nuovi prospetti attraverso networking e outreach
- Partecipare attivamente ai progetti di merceologizzazione, ad esempio: mantenimento quotidiano del merceologico, cambio delle vetrine, trasferimento dei prodotti, ecc.
- Fornire un servizio dopo-vente eccezionale a tutti i clienti
- Fornire il livello più alto di servizio clienti attraverso contatto personalizzato nel mantenimento dei prodotti
- Utilizzare la conoscenza dei prodotti e la selezione per fornire un servizio eccezionale e costruire relazioni con i clienti
- Orientato a squadra
- Sostenere attivamente la sicurezza degli asset aziendali attraverso la prevenzione degli accessi non autorizzati in conformità con le politiche e le procedure aziendali
- Salutare i clienti in modo tempestivo, professionale e personale
- Mantenere attivamente l'apparenza della sede, compreso il mantenimento del merceologico ordinato e attraente.
- Tutti gli altri compiti assegnati dalla gestione

### Requisiti
#### Educazione e Esperienza
- Requisiti
- Deve avere un diploma di scuola superiore e/o equivalente
- Deve possedere una forte esperienza nel settore della vendita di gioielli e orologi di lusso
- Tutti gli aspiranti dovrebbero avere 3-5 anni di esperienza in una posizione di vendita, preferibilmente nel settore di lusso
- Motivato a fornire un servizio eccezionale superando le aspettative dei clienti

- In grado di raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita e di essere orientato agli obiettivi
- Eccellenti abilità verbali e interpersonali
- È un self-starter e utilizza un buon giudizio in tutte le situazioni
- Deve essere in grado di lavorare bene come membro di una squadra in un ambiente veloce e dinamico

- Abilità di costruire relazioni con i clienti
- Deve essere in grado di dimostrare una certa alfabetizzazione informatica
- Flessibile per orari di lavoro retail, compresa la disponibilità nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi.
- In grado di multi-task e gestire priorità cambianti
- In grado di lavorare bene con scarsa supervisione; self-starter

#### Requisiti Fisici
- Requisiti:

Richiede di salire una scala o salire/discendere le scale per rifornire e/o acquisire il merceologico per la vendita. Richiede di sollevare oggetti pesanti 5-25 lbs regolarmente senza assistenza. In certe circostanze, i pesi possono essere più alti. Richiede di lavorare una media di 40 ore a settimana. È necessaria dexterità delle dita.

Customer Service Specialist - Swatch Group

Customer Service Specialist
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc. is looking for a self-motivated and energetic individual with a passion for providing excellent Customer Service and support to our various watch brands such as Omega, Tissot, Longines, Hamilton, and Swatch. This is not your traditional high volume call center environment. This position varies and involves working with Clients, Sales Representatives, and End-consumers.
Profile
Duties and Responsibilities
- Answer all customer inquiries including general information and pricing on the products
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Provide support to our brands and re-sellers
- Utilize company resources for product knowledge and proactive approach to constant refreshing of latest product offerings.
- Responds timely to email inquiries and facilitate departmental deadlines and goals.
- Assist customers by answering phone calls, placing product order and providing shipping status
- Research and respond to customer inquiries in person, phone and e-mail.
- Review and update customer records on computerized data base, SAP system.
- Resolve problems through partnerships with appropriate parties/department heads.
- Research timepieces and parts in the SAP.
- Assure the highest level of customer satisfaction including timely and adequate follow up process.
- Perform due diligence on customer inquiries through oral and written communication.
- Assist in providing initial training to new agents as and when required.
- All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED is required
- Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.
- Previous experience or Knowledge of SAP System is a plus
- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.
- Must be highly organized with superior follow-up skills.
- Must be flexibility to work additional hours during peak season.
- Must be a dependable and reliable team player.
- Must be able to work well in fast-paced environment
- Must have the ability to learn new tasks as needed for upward growth (team and individual)
Physical Requirements
This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Customer Service Specialist to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
It would be a huge plus if you have following work experiences: Customer Service Representative, Customer Service Associate, Customer Service Assistant, Customer Service Coordinator, and Customer Service Agent.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Customer Service Specialist duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
