Marchandiser et formateur visuel - Nord-Est - Swatch Group

Marchandiser et formateur visuel - Nord-Est
La société
Hamilton est un nom emblématique de l'horlogerie de précision depuis sa fondation à Lancaster, en Pennsylvanie, en 1892. Ses montres ont synchronisé les premiers chemins de fer et fourni les poignets de soldats, d'aviateurs et d'étoiles d'Hollywood, faisant plus de 500 apparitions sur grand écran. Hamilton a été à l'avant-garde des innovations dans le design, la technologie et l'artisanat en lançant la première montre électrique du monde en 1957 et la montre numérique LED en 1970. Membre du Swatch Group, leader mondial de la fabrication et de la distribution horlogères, Hamilton allie son esprit américain à une véritable précision suisse.
Description de l'emploi
En tant que marchand et formateur visuel avec Hamilton, aux États-Unis, le poste sera chargé de soutenir les ventes d'horlogerie au sein de notre compte de détail et de gros par la merchandising visuelle et la formation. Ce rôle supervisera la représentation visuelle de notre marque et de nos produits de Hamilton dans toutes les boutiques (de détail et de gros) de la région du Territoire du Nord-Est. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer sera également responsable du maintien des initiatives de formation qui permettront d'accroître la connaissance de la marque et du produit Tissot. Les tâches comprennent la planification, l'organisation, la coordination, la formation et la mise en œuvre de toutes les mesures de marchandisation visuelle qui ont été élaborées par le Tissot.
Cette position est une position sur le terrain.
Profil
Responsabilités en matière de marchandisation visuelle
• Mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des normes de merchandising visuel dans les magasins de détail et de gros, en veillant au respect des directives de l'entreprise et des normes de marque.
• Effectuer régulièrement des visites de magasin pour évaluer l'exécution visuelle, en fournissant des ajustements et des recommandations sur place.
• Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs de volume des ventes en assurant une présentation et une maintenance efficaces de tous les produits
catégories, en s'assurant que tous les magasins sont correctement mis en place pendant les promotions et les affaires régulières.
• Préparer et distribuer le matériel de communication relatif aux affichages visuels conformément aux directives de la marque.
• Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs en plaçant et en suivant les commandes visuelles pour assurer la mise en œuvre en temps voulu et l'envoi centralisé de matériel visuel à l'emplacement commercial.
• Coordonner la distribution interne des matériaux visuels aux magasins, en assurant la conformité et la visibilité.
• Collaborer avec les points de vente, les équipes régionales et la direction de la marque pour planifier et exécuter des ensembles de sol, des vitrines, des transitions saisonnières et des configurations promotionnelles.
• Identifier les possibilités de merchandising visuel à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des magasins, en développant des idées de décoration de fenêtres innovantes.
• Créer et maintenir une bibliothèque photo documentant les conditions de boutique avant et après les visites.
• Fournir des rapports de récapitulation résumant les résultats des visites en magasin et les recommandations d'amélioration.
• Aider le gestionnaire visuel et le gestionnaire de projet SIS à identifier les possibilités de SIS et les besoins de maintenance/rénovation.
• Diriger la configuration et la décoration de première classe d'événements sponsorisés par la marque, liés à la mono- et multi-marque, pour maximiser l'impact visuel.
• S'associer à la direction pour planifier et exécuter la formation fonctionnelle, le développement du leadership, la formation aux produits et aux ventes et d'autres stratégies de formation convenues.
Responsabilités en matière de formation et de perfectionnement
• Faciliter les sessions de formation pour les gérants de magasins et les associés axés sur les normes actuelles de merchandising visuel, le placement de produits et les meilleures pratiques d'expérience client.
• Offrir des programmes complets de communication et de formation aux magasins
• S'associer à la direction pour planifier et exécuter des programmes de formation fonctionnels, de leadership, de produits et de vente.
• Fournir un encadrement continu aux équipes, cerner les lacunes en matière de compétences et recommander des initiatives de développement.
• Favoriser des relations solides avec les équipes de magasin pour favoriser l'adoption de normes visuelles et de formation.
Responsabilités supplémentaires
• Surveiller les tendances des entreprises régionales, les tendances des concurrents en lisant et en comprenant les rapports d'affaires et identifier les possibilités potentielles de soutenir la croissance des ventes.
• S'acquitter d'autres tâches assignées par la direction.
Exigences
Exigences en matière d'éducation et d'expérience
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou DEG requis; diplôme d'études collégiales préféré.
• 2-3 ans d'expérience de merchandising visuel au détail, de préférence dans les produits spécialisés, les bijoux ou les montres.
• Fortes aptitudes à la communication verbale et écrite.
• Compétence en Microsoft Word, Excel et PowerPoint.
• Permis de conduire valide requis.
• Capacité éprouvée d'entraîner et de former diverses équipes dans un environnement de vente rapide.
• Un œil fort pour la conception, la mise en page et la narration de la marque grâce à la présentation du produit.
• Capacité de prioriser les responsabilités multiples et de prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.
• L'horaire de travail varie du lundi au vendredi et peut comprendre un week-end occasionnel.
• Capacité d'atteindre 80 à 85 % du temps (minimum 4 jours par semaine de travail).
Exigences physiques:
Il s'agit principalement d'une position active qui exige du Visual Merchandiser & Trainer qu'il se déplace autour des différents emplacements tout en grimpant en permanence les échelles, en pliant, en s'inclinant, en soulevant, en atteignant, en se déplaçant et en transportant jusqu'à 40 lbs. Il y a des voyages fréquents vers de nombreux points de vente au détail sur le territoire assigné. La position exige la capacité d'utiliser des véhicules à moteur, des ordinateurs et des tablettes, de communiquer clairement et de s'engager physiquement dans des configurations de merchandising visuel. La dextérité du doigt est nécessaire. Travail occasionnel le soir ou le week-end pour soutenir les ouvertures de magasins, les transitions saisonnières, ou des événements spéciaux.
Exigences supplémentaires en matière de compétences :
• Forte capacité d'organisation, de gestion de projet et de résolution de problèmes.
• Communicateur et présentateur de confiance.
• Automotivé, proactif et un apprenant rapide.
• Capacité de travailler indépendamment et en équipe.
• Capacité de rester engagé et réactif lorsque vous travaillez à distance.
• Flexibilité au travail des heures prolongées au besoin.
• Volonté d'accepter les retours et d'améliorer continuellement.

avec ou sans préavis.

The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Description
Swatch General Manager - Times Square (NY) - Swatch Group

The company
Swatch Group is the number one worldwide manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments and is also active in the production and sale of jewelry, movements and components for watches. Among the companies that make up the Swatch Group are Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong multi-brand retail and distribution network with two sophisticated boutiques called Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced technologies such as nanomechanics, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth essential for orology and other industries.

Description of the role
Swatch welcomes the values that coexist between art, design, fashion and technology; and infuses them with their own spark of creativity. Therefore, Swatch is considered a frame on which many expressions have been applied. Avant-garde style, trendy look and technological accents have all contributed to the wonderful aspect of owning a Swatch.

Ideal profile
- Achieve goals through execution of our productivity program, team-member coaching and outstanding client service.
- Liason between Store Staff/Corporate Office and HQ
- Ensure a consistent and respectable store experience for our customers.
- Be able to think strategically and efficiently while running the store as for company standards.
- Possess the ability to prioritize, plan, delegate, and adapt to business needs at various times.
- Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
- Ensure proper staffing of the store through recruitment and retention.
- Create and foster a nourishing environment for the team to determine and succeed.
- Develop and guide a large team of employees.

Professional Requirements
- 5-10 years experience in managing retail stores, preferably in specialized sector
- Passion for the dissemination of SWATCH brand culture
- Good organizational, communication and use of computers
- Ability to drive and maintain an operating and cohesive shop
- Team-oriented

What we offer
- The Swatch Group benefits program is a company that promotes equality of opportunity and engages in environmental sustainability and offers a competitive benefit package that includes:
- Health insurance, dental and glasses (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous contribution of the company)
- Immediate participation at 401(k) and 100% clothing of the company after a year
- Life insurance and long-term insurance
- 18 days of PTO for the year, 23 after 5 years
- 7 days of PTO extended to leave medical, parental and military
- Payment of holidays
- Account Flexible Spending, Disability Short Term, Insurance Damn/Hospital Indemnity
- Discount on company product
- Internal transfer and growth potential
- $500 Corporate Reference Bonifiche

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
The Swatch Group is an international group active in the manufacture and sale of finished watches, jewelry, watch movements and components. Swatch Group supplies nearly all components required for the watches sold by its 17 watch and jewelry brands as well as by its two retail brands, Tourbillon and Hour Passion. The Group’s production companies also supply movements and components to third-party watchmakers. The Swatch Group is also a key player in the manufacture and sale of electronic systems used in watchmaking and other industries. With its watch brands, it is also a leader in the field of sports event timing as official timekeeper and data-handler of most of the Olympic Games of the last decades and major international sports events. The Swatch Group has a unique emotional culture. Beauty, sensuality, emotions in watches are as much part of it as high-tech, quality and added value on the customer’s wrist. Both, emotional poetry and innovation play an active part in the commitment to its customers. The Swatch Group was founded in 1983, by Nicolas G. Hayek. It grew out of the merger of two big Swiss watch groups, ASUAG and SSIH. The Group has since shown steady growth in key financials, leading to records. Today Swatch Group employs more than 33,500 people in over 50 countries.

## Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week
The company
We are recruiting for a Part-Time 20-hour Sales Advisor for our White City Store!

## Job description
### Sales
- Greet and serve all customers providing a fast friendly service.
- Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
- Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Swatch products.
- Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to guaranteed and after sales service.
- Help display merchandise as directed.
- Contribute to the store reaching its monthly sales targets.
- Oversee colleagues on the shop floor to ensure best practise is adhered to at all times, providing on the spot feedback when required.

### Security
- Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till.
- Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
- Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
- All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.

### Reporting
- Accurate reporting of all administration and stock control.
- Collation of sales figures.
- Clearly articulate/communicate any issues the store has had in the absence of the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager.

### Care of the Store
- Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
- Delegate tasks to colleagues to ensure productivity during peak trade.

### Communication
- Adhere to company policies and regulations.
- Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
- Hold briefing sessions in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.
- Confident to communicate at all levels, within the Store and with the wider Swatch Group teams.
- Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
- Be familiar with international customer’s customs and culture.

### Product Knowledge
- Attend regular training programmes.
- Confidently deliver product knowledge and train colleagues on upcoming collections.
- Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
- Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.

### Other
- To undertake duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
- As a member of the store management team be prepared to act up in a more senior capacity when the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager are out of the business.
- Assist the store management team to lead and inspire your colleagues.
- Ensure service standards and behaviours are in line with training and Swatch guidelines at all times.

## Profile
### Essential
- Passionate to lead, motivate and engage a team.
- Driven to improve conversion and ensure the store and team meet KPIs.
- Enjoys developing team members, with the ability to provide constructive and positive feedback.
- Passionate about providing the highest level of customer experience, leading by example for other team members.
- Uses initiative to support the Store Manager and Assistant Manager in running the store and providing ideas for improvements.

### Preferred
- Previous experience in retail and/or fashion accessories.
- Have experience dealing with international customers.
- Ability to communicate in multiple languages.
- Previous supervisory experience.

## Marketing Manager Swiss Market - Swatch Group

## Descrizione
Das Pluszeichen im Logo steht für die Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit, für die Tissot seit 1853 bekannt ist. Tissot bleibt seinem Leitspruch „Innovators by Tradition“ treu. Die Uhren der Marke werden in mehr als 160 Ländern verkauft und sind authentisch und erschwinglich. Zudem bieten sie besondere Materialien, fortschrittliche Funktionalitäten und ein ausgefeiltes Design.

## Job description
Für unsere Schweizer Markt Abteilung suchen wir im Hauptsitz in Le Locle eine/n dynamische/n und motivierte/n Marketing Manager welche/r sich mit unserem Unternehmen identifizieren kann.

In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die Leitung der Marketing Abteilung im Schweizer Markt und führen ein Team von einem Mitarbeiter.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet umfasst folgende Tätigkeiten:
- Management, Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Überwachung des Marketingplans für den Schweizer Markt (traditionelle und digitale Medien, Partnerschaften, Events und PR) gemäß den Vorgaben von Tissot International
- Verantwortung für sowie Erstellung und Optimierung des lokalen Marketingbudgets für den Schweizer Markt
- Leitung des Marketingteams für den Schweizer Markt
- Planung und Überwachung des kooperativen Marketingplans mit Key Accounts und dem Retail
- Definition, Planung und Überwachung von Promotionen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden
- Koordination zwischen dem Tissot International Marketing und dem Schweizer Markt
- Umsetzung lokaler Schweizer Partnerschaftsverträge
- Management von Schweizer Friends of the Brand

Zusätzlich zu Ihren täglichen Aufgaben, betreuen Sie verschiedene Projekte und arbeiten täglich in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Brand Manager, der Logistik, der Dekoration Abteilung, dem Verkauf, Tissot International und mit externen Kunden.

## Profile
Wir suchen eine dynamische und innovative Persönlichkeit, welche sich dank schneller Auffassungsangabe und Kreativität, schnell diversen Situationen anpassen kann.

Als starker Teamplayer und begeisterungsfähiges und kommunikatives Vorbild mit hervorragenden Führungsqualitäten besitzen Sie die Fähigkeit, auf Ihre Mitarbeitenden einzugehen, diese zu fördern und zu motivieren und gute menschliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Ihr exzellentes Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick macht Sie zu einem scharfsinnigen Manager, der in der Lage ist, selbstständig und zuverlässig zu arbeiten. Ihr Talent zur Erarbeitung und Präsentation von Konzepten rundet Ihr Profil ab. Dabei zeigen Sie Durchsetzungsvermögen und Anpassungsfähigkeit, wenn sich Situationen und Prioritäten ändern. Zudem sind Sie bereit, mehrmals pro Jahr Wochenendarbeiten zu leisten.

## Professional requirements
Sie haben eine Ausbildung als Eid. Dipl. Marketingleiter oder ähnliches abgeschlossen und bringen mind. 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung als Projektleiter Marketing mit, sowie 2-3 Jahre Führungserfahrung. Sie besitzen sehr gute Kenntnisse bezüglich Kommunikation, wie Klassische Werbung, Digital Marketing, Social Media und Events. Sie haben bereits Erfahrung in schnelllebigen Arbeitsumfeldern in der ganzen Schweiz gesammelt und mehrere komplexe Projekte gleichzeitig geleitet.

## Languages
Sie verfügen über eine einwandfreie Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch und Französisch, sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

## Corporate HR Process Specialist - Swatch Group

## Descrizione del Posto
Swatch Group è un gruppo internazionale che si occupa della produzione e della vendita di montres, gioielli, componenti e movimenti orologici. Fornisce quasi tutti i componenti necessari alla produzione delle montres vendute dalle sue 16 marche orologerie e gioielleria, nonché dalle sue due marche di distribuzione.

## Descrizione del Posto
Per il nostro sede a Bienne, cerchiamo una persona motivata, competente e dinamica per il ruolo di Corporate HR Process Specialist.

## Descrizione del Posto
In questa posizione, sarai responsabile di supportare, sviluppare e pianificare l'attività dell'team fornendo presentazioni e analisi relative ai processi RH, Controlling RH e C&B per tutte le società del Swatch Group (~ 100 entità). Le tue attività avranno l'obiettivo di facilitare le decisioni del Management e del gruppo.

## Descrizione del Posto
Le tue principali responsabilità saranno:
- Pianificare, coordinare e sviluppare i processi RH del Gruppo
- Esaminare e analizzare i dati consolidati per fornire raccomandazioni (data analytics)
- Pianificare e eseguire le analisi necessarie per il Compensation & Benefits (inclusi i benefici sociali) e il Controlling RH (benchmarks)
- Sostenere i dipartimenti RH delle nostre aziende con diverse analisi
- Partecipare e sviluppare vari progetti interni

## Profil
- Alti livelli di capacità analitiche, matematiche, organizzative e orientate alla soluzione dei problemi
- Abilità con i numeri e le analisi dei dati
- Sensazione di responsabilità e volontà di efficienza, lavorando autonomamente e in team

## Requisiti
- Titolo universitario o HES (Economia, Gestion d’entreprise) o titolo considerato equivalente
- Conoscenze specifiche del Compensation & Benefits, in Svizzera e a livello internazionale
- Abilità con Excel, Powerpoint e altri strumenti informatici
- Lingue: Deve avere una buona conoscenza della lingua principale francese o tedesca, oltre a una buona conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'anglais

## Technicien Atelier Laboratoire (H/F) - Swatch Group

## Introduction de la società
OMEGA è una prestigiosa marca orologica mondiale conosciuta per le sue elevate esigenze di qualità, precisione e innovazione da oltre 170 anni. Le nostre orologi contengono tra le più belle al mondo e si caratterizzano per la loro tecnologia avanzata e lo stile eterno.

Durante la nostra lunga storia, abbiamo superato record di precisione, ridefinito il cronometaggio sportivo e mantenuto la nostra posizione all'avanguardia della Alta Orlogeria.

Come marca internazionale, siamo sempre interessati a incontrare futuri colleghi che desiderano contribuire al lavoro delle nostre squadre su quasi ogni continente con i loro talenti, ambizioni e ispirazioni.

## Descrizione del poste
### Maintenance & Support technique
- Realizzare la manutenzione curativa e preventiva degli equipaggi di misurazione
- Diagnosticare e risolvere le guasti in coordinamento con i servizi interni e/o i fornitori esterni
- Seguire le azioni di manutenzione in collaborazione con i servizi transversali (IT, Manutenzione, Real estate...) e esterni
- Garantire la buona tenuta, la fiabilità e la disponibilità degli equipaggi
- Effettuare il follow-up e la creazione dei tickets di richiesta di servizio per la manutenzione degli equipaggi di manipolazione

### Development & Qualification
- Generare, adattare e implementare le metodologie necessarie alla qualificazione dei nuovi prodotti sugli equipaggi di misurazione
- Partecipare all'ampliamento continuo dei processi e delle metodologie di qualificazione
- Assicurare il supporto tecnico agli utenti in orari non tipici

### Organizzazione & Logistica
- Ordinare gli strumenti, i consumabili e gli equipaggi necessari alle attività del laboratorio
- Regolare e controllare i flussi logistici legati alle operazioni del laboratorio

### Coordination & Interface
- Servire come primo punto di contatto per le squadre operative su argomenti tecnici legati al laboratorio
- Collaborare con i vari dipartimenti interni (qualità, industrializzazione, produzione, metodi, logistica)

## Profil
- Tecnico ES in microtecnica, elettronica, automatico o formazione giudicata equivalente
- Esperienza confermata nella manutenzione degli equipaggi industriali o di misurazione
- Esperienza nelle metodologie industriali (produzione, processi, industrializzazione)
- Maestria degli strumenti informatici Microsoft Office
- Azienda nella redazione di documenti tecnici e report di intervento
- Conoscenze nella programmazione o parametriazione degli equipaggi di misurazione (atout)
- Comprensione dei flussi logistici e utilizzo degli strumenti ERP (atout)
- Esperienza di successo nel management transversale o diretto (atout)

## Competenze richieste
- Capacità di evolversi all'interno di equipaggi pluridisciplinari e transversali
- Azienda nella collaborazione con vari dipartimenti e fornitori
- Spirito analitico, rigore, senso della sintesi
- Persona strutturata, organizzata, minutiosa
- Autonoma, proattiva, flessibile e polivalente
- Azienda in un ruolo di supporto tecnico alle squadre
- Capacità di risolvere problemi tecnici in modo metodico

- Francese: corrente (orale & scritto)
- Inglese: buono livello (orale & scritto)

descriptionByLocale.en: Controller Medior/ Senior at the intersection of Business & Finance control - Swatch Group Controller Medior/ Senior at the intersection of Business & Finance control Bedrijfsintroductie A versatile job where you will balance subject matter between Finance and Business but also be an important point of contact for your team. Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of watches. With 16 watch brands, the Group is represented in all price ranges, additionally active in the production and sale of jewelry, watch developments and components. Swatch Group represents the following watch brands, among others: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail network with two sophisticated boutiques under the name Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is a major player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential for watchmaking and other industries. From our headquarters in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, we supply independent jewelers and chain stores. In addition, The Swatch Group Netherlands has a growing number of its own outlets, such as Swatch Stores, Tissot Boutique and an Hour Passion in the Designer Outlet in Roermond. For the head office in the Netherlands (Eindhoven) we are immediately looking for a: Business/ finance Controller (full-time and on location). Functie As Controller you will be the sparring partner for the Commercial organization and contribute to the further development and professionalization of the Finance team. As Controller you are fully PnL responsible for our B2B business activities and you have an overarching and coordinating role in key processes such as monthly closing, budget and sales forecast. In this role you function as the right hand of the CFO. Key activities and responsibilities: Contribute to our growth strategy by delivering compelling analysis and presentations Provide insight into gross and net margin development Support and advise in the preparation of business cases for the opening of new outlets Reporting forecasts both commercially and financially Active contribution in the monthly closing in cooperation with the other Finance colleagues Preparation of cash flow analyses and projections and capex controlling Presenting the operational and commercial results to the management (CEO & CFO). There are also opportunities, for example, to automate and optimize reporting. We also see opportunities to further improve processes. Profiel Furthermore, do you recognize yourself in; HBO+ or WO educated with at least 3 -5 years of relevant work experience Making clear financial analyses for management to operations A team mentality, but able to work independently Skill in working with various IT systems, such as SAP, SAP BW and Office 365 Good skills in the English language where Dutch is an advantage. You function well in an organization; Which is dynamic. Working ad hoc, prioritizing, switching quickly gives you energy In development. Growth ambition and we work on long-term relationships Where we value work atmosphere and working in the office is the norm Who is Corporate but see a lot of potential in process improvements. Aanbod What will you get from us? The opportunity to work in a growing, international organization in the center of Eindhoven An independent, but certainly also challenging, and versatile position for 40 hours per week A competitive and interesting benefits package, including 26 vacation days based on full-time employment Excellent pension accrual The opportunity to take out collective health insurance through The Swatch Group; Veld 7 Are you excited? Please respond via the application button and we will contact you as soon as possible. Any questions? Please contact Erik van Mullem from the HR department. Con 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è rappresentato in tutte le fasce di prezzo, inoltre attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, orologi e componenti. Swatch Group rappresenta i seguenti marchi di orologi, tra gli altri: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte rete di distribuzione e vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie. Dalla nostra sede a Eindhoven, nei Paesi Bassi, forniamo gioiellieri indipendenti e negozi di catene. Inoltre, il Gruppo Swatch Paesi Bassi ha un numero crescente di propri outlet, come Swatch Stores, Tissot Boutique e una Passione d'Oro nel Designer Outlet di Roermond. ## Functie As Controller sarai il partner sparring per l'organizzazione Commerciale e contribuirai all'ulteriore sviluppo e professionalità del team Finance. descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Data Scientist (all genders) - on-site presence - Swatch Group Data Scientist (all genders) - on-site presence The company Behind every record, there are years of intensive training and the athlete’s desire to produce excellent performances. Behind the result, there is profound know-how and the high precision of Swiss Timing’s state-of-the-art technology. If you want to participate in the future development of high level sport events ... we are looking for you! Globally active, our company is constantly seeking for employees determined to progress and strive in a highly innovative environment. As a company of the Swatch Group, we are committed to quality of life, health and safety, and the environment. We are eager to hire employees with a sustainable mindset.

## Mansioni
- Your primary mission is the refinement, interpretation, and advanced analysis of measured sports data, contributing to both live and post-processing systems used across a wide range of sports and technologies.
- You will work with signal processing, statistical analysis, and machine learning, developing robust algorithms and analytics pipelines that convert sensor data into reliable, sport-specific performance metrics.
- Design, implement, and maintain data processing pipelines and algorithms for live and post-event analytics across firmware and software stages
- Apply signal processing techniques (e.g. filtering, smoothing, resampling) and implement position estimation using Real Time Tracking System, computer vision, and IMU data
- Analyze and contextualize sports data; develop activity recognition algorithms and compute key performance metrics (e.g. speed, acceleration, jump height, rotation)
- Extract and communicate actionable insights for athletes, federations, and media
- Apply statistical analysis to complex datasets and develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models (supervised & unsupervised)
- Create tailored analyses and visualizations for internal and external stakeholders
- Ensure data quality through systematic testing, validation, and performance monitoring; enhance robustness and reliability of outputs
- Contribute to innovation by developing new systems, analytics pipelines, and continuously improving existing technologies

## Requisiti
### Profilo
- Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills
- High affinity for data-driven problem solving and complex systems
- Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style
- Ability to communicate complex data and insights in a clear and understandable way
- Interest in sports and data-driven performance analysis
- Detail-oriented and quality-focused, especially when working with sensitive data
- Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary environments
- Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn and explore new technologies and methods
- Proactive mindset with a drive to improve and innovate existing solutions

### Requisiti professionali
- Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field
- Strong background in statistics, machine learning, and signal processing
- Proficiency in Python; experience with C++ or C# is an advantage
- Experience with data visualization and scientific analysis workflows
- Solid understanding of scientific methodology and experimental validation
- Ability to work independently on complex analytical problems while collaborating effectively in a team

### Lingue
- Good communication skills in English are required.

- Company address Swiss Timing LTD Rue de l’Envers 1 P.O. box 138 CH-2606 Corgémont

- Analizzare e contestualizzare i dati sportivi; sviluppare algoritmi di riconoscimento delle attività e calcolare le metriche delle prestazioni chiave (ad esempio velocità, accelerazione, altezza di salto, rotazione)

- Garantire la qualità dei dati attraverso test sistematici, validazione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni; migliorare robustezza e affidabilità delle uscite

- Curiosità e motivazione per imparare ed esplorare continuamente nuove tecnologie e metodi

- Laurea in Scienze dei dati, Informatica, Ingegneria, Fisica, Matematica, o un campo relativo

descriptionByLocale.en: Description Senior Legal Counsel (H/F) 100% Brand Protection / Online IP Enforcement - Swatch Group ## Company Description - The Swatch Group is the leading company in the Swiss watch industry. - Our group based in Biel owns 16 renowned watch brands, present in all price segments. - As the largest manufacturer of Swiss Made watches with activities covering design, production, and distribution, we also focus on sustainability by integrating an ecologically responsible approach in our 150 Swiss production facilities. - Joining the Swatch Group means becoming part of a dynamic company with over 30 subsidiaries worldwide, which values innovation and passion. ## Our Offer - versatile and international - We offer you exciting, challenging, and varied challenges in a diverse and dynamic working environment within an international group. - You act as a point of contact for several subsidiaries and make a significant contribution to their business success. - The focus of this role is the protection of intellectual property rights (trademarks, design, and copyright) and online counterfeiting. - Working hand in hand with decision-makers at all hierarchy levels, you act as their strategic partner, providing advisory support. ## Your Contribution - knowledgeable and linguistically proficient - You advise and support our in- and foreign subsidiaries in all legal matters concerning brand protection and online IP enforcement. - You apply your in-depth legal knowledge in the field of digital technologies and intellectual property rights, as well as your experience in IP litigation. - You manage complex projects from a legal perspective in multiple languages and develop creative solutions independently. - You recognize legal and economic relationships and assess opportunities and risks quickly and correctly. - If necessary, you handle processes in collaboration with external lawyers domestically and abroad. ## Your Profile - competent and engaged - You preferably hold a Swiss lawyer's patent or equivalent education and have a good understanding of intellectual property law. - Additionally, you have several years of professional experience in a company or economic law firm. - Your strengths include perseverance, assertiveness, negotiation skills, and a positive attitude towards your tasks. - You are interested in technical issues and enjoy discovering and developing new subject areas. - Working both independently and team-oriented, you are responsible and demonstrate a strong willingness to provide a high-quality service. - You speak and write German, French, and English above average, can draft legal texts in these languages, and conduct negotiations. ## Your new professional adventure begins here! - Choosing the Swatch Group means being part of a community determined to shape the future. - Here, every contribution is valuable and has the potential to influence our common path. - In our companies, we appreciate the direct human relationship with our employees, which is why we do not offer home office. - Are you ready for new challenges? We look forward to receiving your application. ## Work Location - Faubourg du Lac / Seevorstadt 6 - 2502 Biel/Bienne (Bern) - Switzerland ## Company Address - The Swatch Group AG - Seevorstadt 6 - Postfach CH-2501 Biel ## Application - Apply for this position - Share this job offer

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione # Responsable Achats & Sous-Traitance (H/F) - site de Delémont - Swatch Group Responsable Achats & Sous-Traitance (H/F) - site de Delémont ## Introduction de la société Depuis 1735, la Manufacture Blancpain produit des montres d'exception grâce au savoir-faire et à l'expertise de collaboratrices et collaborateurs passionnés. La division Blancpain Habillage est active dans la fabrication de boîtes de montres et de bracelets de prestige. Notre entreprise dispose d’un savoir-faire largement reconnu et d’un centre de production muni d’équipements de dernière génération. Pour notre département Supply Chain, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Responsable Achats & Sous-Traitance (H/F) pour notre site de Delémont. ## Description du poste - Encadrer les collaborateurs, organiser et gérer le département des achats/sous-traitance - Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’approvisionnement et de sous-traitance en fonction des buts et objectifs de la société visant à permettre sa croissance en s’inspirant des bonnes pratiques du domaine - Participer à l’établissement des offres et le calcul des prix de revient de nos produits en maintenant à jour les coûts d’approvisionnement, respectivement la saisie des informations nécessaires dans les supports de calculation des offres - Comprendre, identifier et anticiper les besoins pour mettre en place des mesures concrètes visant à les satisfaire - Bâtir et entretenir des partenariats constructifs avec les parties prenantes clés - Prospecter les marchés afin d’optimiser nos sources d’approvisionnement et répartir les risques (bi-sourcing, re-sourcing) aux meilleures conditions (qualité, prix et délais) - Négocier, le cas échéant conclure des contrats cadres pour nos produits ou services, nécessaires à la production de l’entreprise et à son bon fonctionnement - Evaluer les performances des fournisseurs et contribuer à la fiabilisation de nos sources d’approvisionnement en collaboration avec le département Qualité - Contribuer à assurer une meilleure rentabilité de nos produits (optimisation coûts et marges) - Permettre l’amélioration continue de nos processus en étant force de proposition et en assurant une veille stratégique achats ## Profil - Diplôme HEG, Brevet Fédéral d’acheteur ou autre titre jugé équivalent - Expérience minimum de 5 ans en tant qu’Acheteur Stratégique ou poste similaire - Expérience avérée en Achats et gestion des collaborateurs - Expérience dans le domaine de l’industrie horlogère - Sensibilité commerciale couplée à un esprit analytique et stratégique - Sens de la négociation, la discrétion, des priorités et des responsabilités - Excellentes capacités organisationnelles, de communication et interpersonnelles - Maîtrise des outils MS Office et d’un ERP, SAP un avantage - Proactif et résistant au stress - Aptitude à synthétiser les données et créer des reporting d’aide à la décision - Autonome, pragmatique et apte à travailler en équipe ## Lieu de travail Route de la Communance 2800 Delémont (Jura) Suisse ## Adresse de l'entreprise Blancpain SA Le Rocher 12 CH-1348 Le Brassus ## Postuler pour ce poste Partagez cette annonce
descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Responsabile Acquisti & Outsourcing (M/F) - sede di Delémont - Swatch Group ## Introduzione dell'azienda Dal 1735, la Manufactura Blancpain produce orologi d'eccezione grazie alla competenza e all'esperienza di collaboratrici e collaboratori appassionati. Contribuire a garantire una maggiore redditività dei nostri prodotti (ottimizzazione dei costi e dei margini) - Consentire il miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi essendo una forza di proposta e assicurando una vigilanza strategica sugli acquisti ## Profilo - descriptionByLocale.en: Description Purchasing & Subcontracting Manager (M/F) - Delémont site - Swatch Group ## Company Introduction Since 1735, the Blancpain Manufacture has been producing exceptional watches thanks to the expertise and passion of its employees. The Blancpain Habillage division is active in the manufacture of watch cases and prestige bracelets. Our company has a widely recognized know-how and a production center equipped with state-of-the-art equipment. For our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Purchasing & Subcontracting Manager (M/F) for our Delémont site. ## Job Description - Supervise employees, organize and manage the purchasing/subcontracting department - Develop and implement procurement and subcontracting strategies based on the company's goals and objectives, aiming to enable its growth by drawing on best practices in the field - Participate in the preparation of offers and the calculation of return prices for our products, keeping procurement costs up to date and entering necessary information into offer calculation tools - Understand, identify and anticipate needs to implement concrete measures to satisfy them - Build and maintain constructive partnerships with key stakeholders - Explore markets to optimize our procurement sources and distribute risks (bi-sourcing, re-sourcing) under the best conditions (quality, price and deadlines) - Negotiate, and possibly conclude framework contracts for our products or services necessary for the company's production and smooth operation - Evaluate supplier performance and contribute to securing our procurement sources in collaboration with the Quality department - Contribute to ensuring greater profitability of our products (cost and margin optimization) - Enable continuous improvement of our processes by being a driving force and ensuring strategic purchasing monitoring ## Profile - HEG diploma, Federal Purchaser's Certificate or equivalent title - Minimum 5 years of experience as a Strategic Purchaser or similar position - Proven experience in Purchasing and personnel management - Experience in the watchmaking industry - Commercial sensitivity combined with an analytical and strategic mindset - Sense of negotiation, discretion, priorities and responsibilities - Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills - MS Office and ERP skills, SAP an advantage - Proactive and stress-resistant - Ability to synthesize data and create decision-support reports - Autonomous, pragmatic and able to work in a team ## Work Location Route de la Communance 2800 Delémont (Jura) Switzerland ## Company Address Blancpain SA Le Rocher 12 CH-1348 Le Brassus ## Apply for this position Share this ad
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Einkaufs- und Unterauftragsleiter (m/w) - Standort Delémont - Swatch Group ## Unternehmensvorstellung Seit 1735 produziert die Manufacture Blancpain außergewöhnliche Uhren dank der Expertise und Leidenschaft seiner Mitarbeiter. Die Division Blancpain Habillage ist aktiv in der Herstellung von Uhrengestellen und prestigevollen Armbändern. Unser Unternehmen verfügt über ein weithin anerkanntes Know-how und ein Produktionszentrum mit modernsten Einrichtungen. Für unsere Abteilung Supply Chain suchen wir einen Einkaufs- und Unterauftragsleiter (m/w) für unseren Standort Delémont. ## Stellenbeschreibung - Mitarbeiter beaufsichtigen, organisieren und verwalten die Einkaufs- und Unterauftragsabteilung - Strategien für den Einkauf und die Unterauftragsvergabe entwickeln und umsetzen, basierend auf den Zielen und Vorgaben des Unternehmens, um dessen Wachstum durch die Übernahme bewährter Praktiken in diesem Bereich zu ermöglichen - An der Erstellung von Angeboten und der Kalkulation von Rückpreisen für unsere Produkte teilnehmen, indem die Einkaufskosten auf dem neuesten Stand gehalten und die erforderlichen Informationen in die Berechnungstools für Angebote eingegeben werden - Bedürfnisse verstehen, identifizieren und antizipieren, um konkrete Maßnahmen zu ihrer Befriedigung umzusetzen - Konstruktive Partnerschaften mit wichtigen Interessengruppen aufbauen und aufrechterhalten - Märkte erkunden, um unsere Einkaufsquellen zu optimieren und Risiken (Bi-Sourcing, Re-Sourcing) unter den besten Bedingungen (Qualität, Preis und Fristen) zu verteilen - Verhandlungen führen und gegebenenfalls Rahmenverträge für unsere Produkte oder Dienstleistungen abschließen, die für die Produktion des Unternehmens und dessen reibungslosen Betrieb erforderlich sind - Lieferantenleistung bewerten und zur Sicherung unserer Einkaufsquellen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung beitragen - Zur Gewährleistung einer höheren Rentabilität unserer Produkte beitragen (Kosten- und Margenoptimierung) - Die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Prozesse ermöglichen, indem wir eine treibende Kraft sind und eine strategische Überwachung des Einkaufs sicherstellen ## Profil - Diplom HEG, eidgenössisches Diplom für Einkäufer oder gleichwertiger Titel - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als strategischer Einkäufer oder in ähnlicher Position - Erfahrung im Einkauf und in der Personalführung - Erfahrung in der Uhrenindustrie - Kommerzielle Sensibilität, kombiniert mit analytischem und strategischem Denken - Verhandlungssinn, Diskretion, Prioritäten und Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Hervorragende organisatorische, kommunikative und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten - MS Office- und ERP-Kenntnisse, SAP von Vorteil - Proaktiv und stressresistent - Fähigkeit, Daten zu synthetisieren und entscheidungsunterstützende Berichte zu erstellen - Autonom, pragmatisch und fähig, im Team zu arbeiten ## Arbeitsort Route de la Communance 2800 Delémont (Jura) Schweiz ## Unternehmensadresse Blancpain SA Le Rocher 12 CH-1348 Le Brassus ## Bewerben Sie sich für diese Stelle Teilen Sie diese Anzeige
